name: showreel-c3-looks-expensive

voice.text: Too much is going on. It looks cheap. Turns out, quiet looks expensive. First, give it room. Next, shrink and space the name. Then, keep just two colours. Same product, now it looks premium.

caption:
Too much is going on. This label looks cheap. 🍯

1. Give it room. Empty space around the name says nothing is fighting for attention.
2. Shrink and space the name. Small capitals with a little extra spacing read calm and confident.
3. Keep just two colours. Fewer colours read as a choice, not a mix.

Save this for your next label, logo or price tag. Which of these does your own label break?
keywords: how to make design look expensive

sources.title: How to Create a Luxurious User Experience (CXL): white space, fewer products, fewer colours
